cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Cílem předmětu je vymezit nezbytné předpoklady pro práci manažera v dřevozpracujícím průmyslu a poskytnout ucelený výklad manažerské ekonomiky. Předmět zahrnuje základní oblasti rozhodování podniku, jakými jsou majetková a kapitálová struktura podniku, jednotlivé podnikové funkce, jejich vzájemné vztahy, ale i prohloubení znalostí v oblasti produkční a nákladové analýzy chování firem, poptávky, tržních struktur, krátkodobého a dlouhodobého rozhodování.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of course is to identify the necessary preconditions for managerial work in the wood processing industry and provide a comprehensive interpretation of managerial economics. The course covers basic areas of enterprise decisions such as property and capital structure, individual corporate functions, their mutual relations but also to deepen knowledge in the field of production and cost analysis of the behaviour of enterprises, demand, market structures, short- and long-term decisions.

en.content: 1.Economic principles, economic management of enterprise. (allowance 0/2)2.Sector and market structure, optimization of enterprise size on the market. (allowance 0/2)3.The demand on the product market as a factor of business decision. (allowance 0/2)4.Behaviour in the enterprise market structures. (allowance 0/2)5.Relationship between economic variables of the wood processing enterprise. (allowance 0/2)6.Modelling of economic variables, budgeting, costing tasks for decision-making. (allowance 0/2)7.Registration and information systems of wood processing enterprises, the use of accounting information for managerial decisions. (allowance 0/2)8.Managerial information systems and their role in the management of wood processing enterprise. (allowance 0/2)9.Managerial decision tasks. (allowance 0/2)10.Pricing decisions and price policy. (allowance 0/2)11.Strategic decision-making tasks. (allowance 0/2)12.Innovation and marketing. (allowance 0/2)13.Analysis, controlling, internal audit. (allowance 0/2)14.Environmental aspects of the wood processing enterprise. (allowance 0/2)

en.content: Credit is required for successful completion of course.
